name: Load-Balanced Isosurfacing on Multi-GPU Clusters
definition: A technique that efficiently distributes isosurfacing workloads to GPU compute resources within a cluster by using a modest amount of preprocessing to estimate work required for volume blocks, maximizing load uniformity over user-defined isovalues.
summary: Load-Balanced Isosurfacing on Multi-GPU Clusters efficiently distributes workloads by estimating computational costs to maximize load uniformity, unlike naive round-robin assignment.
